title: Feedback World Model Enables Precise Guidance of Diffusion Policy
why: Closest online-correction anchor: executed observations update a shared latent feedback state that corrects later world predictions and guides manipulation actions under shift.

title: Adapting World Models with Latent-State Dynamics Residuals
why: ReDRAW is the load-bearing residual-dynamics baseline for calibrating a visual latent world model to changed mechanisms, though its adaptation is offline and not VLA manipulation.

title: CheckVLA: Execution-Time Verification with Action-Conditioned World Model for Long-Horizon Mobile Manipulation
why: Direct execution-time comparator for action-conditioned residual detection, calibrated intervention, and suffix rewriting during long-horizon VLA manipulation.

title: When to Trust Imagination: Adaptive Action Execution for World Action Models
why: Direct abstention and replanning anchor that tests future-reality consistency to decide how long a WAM action chunk remains trustworthy.

title: DreamX-Phi 1.0: Action-Conditioned Video World Model for Robotic Manipulation
why: Recent action-conditioned video-WM backbone whose geometry, arm-identity, and object-consistency constraints define a strong training-time alternative to online residual correction.

title: τ_0-WM: A Unified Video-Action World Model for Robotic Manipulation
why: Central action-conditioned simulator and candidate-ranking baseline that already uses imagined futures for proposal evaluation and rectification before execution.

title: DREAM-Chunk: Reactive Action Chunking with Latent World Model
why: Closest candidate-action transport neighbor: each real observation is matched against phase-aligned latent futures to switch among unexecuted VLA action chunks online.

title: Leave No Observation Behind: Real-time Correction for VLA Action Chunks
why: A2C2 is the primary per-step VLA residual-correction baseline and is needed to separate WAM prediction-residual transport from ordinary action-head correction.
